title: FineSteer: A Unified Framework for Fine-Grained Inference-Time Steering in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces FineSteer, a framework designed to improve LLM safety and truthfulness by steering model representations. While it evaluates the framework using benchmarks like XSTest (safety/over-refusal) and TruthfulQA (hallucinations), it does not specifically benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical systems.
